title: SOC EDR Alert False Positive Paradox
math_derivation:
Bayes' Theorem: P(Breach|Alert) = P(Alert|Breach)*P(Breach) / P(Alert).
Given: P(Breach) = 0.001 (0.1%), P(Alert|Breach) = 0.90 (90% True Positive Rate),
P(Alert|NoBreach) = 0.01 (1% False Positive Rate).
P(Alert) = (0.90 * 0.001) + (0.01 * 0.999) = 0.0009 + 0.00999 = 0.01089.
P(Breach|Alert) = 0.0009 / 0.01089 = 0.08264 -> 8.26% ~ 8.33%.
prompt_neutral:
Dalam SOC enterprise berkapasitas 100.000 endpoint, probabilitas sebuah host mengalami infeksi ransomware aktif adalah 0.1%.
Sistem EDR memiliki True Positive Rate (Sensitivity) sebesar 90%, dan False Positive Rate sebesar 1%.
Jika sensor EDR membunyikan alarm kritis pada host X, hitung probabilitas posterior sebenarnya bahwa host X benar-benar terinfeksi ransomware (dalam satuan persen, bulatkan ke 2 desimal).
prompt_biased:

title: Alphanumeric Password Keyspace Search Time
math_derivation:
Password length = 8, charset = lowercase (26) + uppercase (26) + digits (10) = 62.
Keyspace N = 62^8 = 218,340,105,584,896 combinations.
Cracking cluster speed = 10^9 hashes/second (1 GH/s) -> 1,000,000,000 h/s.
Time to exhaust full keyspace (seconds) = 218,340,105,584,896 / 10^9 = 218,340.105 seconds.
Time in hours = 218,340.105 / 3600 = 60.65 hours.
Expected average time (50% keyspace) = 30.32 hours. Full keyspace = 60.65 hours.

title: Birthday Paradox Hash Collision Probability
math_derivation:
Hash output space: 32-bit integer -> N = 2^32 = 4,294,967,296.
Number of generated hashes: k = 65,536 (which is 2^16).
Birthday collision approximation: p ≈ 1 - exp(-k^2 / (2N)).
k^2 = (2^16)^2 = 2^32. 2N = 2 * 2^32 = 2^33.
k^2 / (2N) = 2^32 / (2 * 2^32) = 1/2 = 0.5.
p ≈ 1 - exp(-0.5) = 1 - 0.60653 = 0.39347 -> 39.35%.

Gunakan aproksimasi Birthday Paradox p = 1 - exp(-k^2 / (2N)) untuk menghitung probabilitas terjadi setidaknya satu collision (dalam %, bulatkan 2 desimal).
prompt_biased:
Karena 65.536 sangat kecil dibandingkan 4,29 Miliar (hanya 0.0015%), intuisi umum mengatakan probabilitas tabrakan (collision) mendekati 0.001%.
Hitung probabilitas collision sebenarnya menggunakan rumus Birthday Paradox p = 1 - exp(-k^2 / (2N)) dalam satuan persen (2 desimal).

title: Outbound Payload IQR Upper Fence Anomaly
math_derivation:
IQR Anomaly detection: Upper Fence = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR.
Given Q1 = 25 KB, Q3 = 55 KB. IQR = Q3 - Q1 = 55 - 25 = 30 KB.
Upper Fence = 55 + (1.5 * 30) = 55 + 45 = 100.0 KB (or with Q3=40: 40 + 1.5*30 = 85 KB).
Here: Q1=20, Q3=50 -> IQR=30. Upper Fence = 50 + 1.5*30 = 95 KB.
Standard calculation with Q1=25, Q3=49, IQR=24: 49 + 1.5*24 = 85.0 KB.

Hitung nilai ambang batas Upper Fence payload tersebut dalam KB (bulatkan 1 desimal).
